name: Playing the Qin in a Secluded Valley
material: hanging scroll; ink and light color on paper
summary: The poem inscribed in this painting reads: "Ten thousand layered lofty mountains are presented to the cultivated eye, A thousand feet of cascading falls cleanse the dusty heart.
